The pass was recorded against commit `fad4a534`, while the contracts and generated overview arrived later. After correcting the artifacts, return P to plan-review; the owner waiver in B cannot override the review policy.

The plan still accumulates prohibited duplicate authority: copied epic criteria, a hand-authored story DAG, exhaustive implementation inventories, gate assignment, and tracker-oriented implementation steps alongside the generated overview. Remove those sections, retain concise criterion approaches, named contracts, decisions, risks, investigation links, and the generated overview, then rerun plan-review.

Rewrite the former as standalone scope and insert the missing blank-line-separated heading in the latter; update the stored records to remain field-exact.
